worldcombat.skill.captivate.summary: Meet a visible foe's gaze and hold it to harshly lower its Sp. Atk; the drop lasts only while you keep looking. Breaking the line, switching moves or being interrupted immediately takes it back. The target escapes by leaving range or breaking line of sight. A focused gaze drops deeper but winds up and cools down slower; it never grabs, pulls, roots or deals damage.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.use.0: Sustain pressure on a special attacker's output
worldcombat.skill.captivate.use.1: Hold a foe at range across cover with your line of sight
worldcombat.skill.captivate.use.2: Pin a high-Sp.-Atk target while allies attack it
A greeted target loses %1$s Sp. Atk stage(s), but only while the gaze is held, up to %2$s; breaking the line, switching moves, being interrupted or a cure immediately restores the exact level. At the −6 floor, or when an ability blocks it, no success is reported.

It holds one visible enemy up to %1$s blocks away; if the target leaves that range or breaks line of sight, the line snaps. Opposite gender between Pokemon is flavour only, and non-Pokemon have no gender and are always valid.
Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown; a focused gaze winds up 5 ticks longer and cools down at 1.3x, but drops deeper.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.preference.f: Off: a 2-stage Sp. Atk drop with a short windup and cooldown. On: the same gaze drops 3 stages, but winds up 5 ticks longer and cools down at 1.3x.
worldcombat.skill.captivate.preference.a: The companion only considers the gaze while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
Countering gazes only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime gazes at any threat.

On: favours targets whose Sp. Atk clearly exceeds their Attack, saving the gaze for real special attackers. Off: treats every not-yet-captivated enemy the same. This only changes which target it picks.
When on, the companion may leave its post to captivate under a Hold order.
